name: Common Weakness Enumeration
description: Source-level record for CWE. The versioned editions live in their own directories (for example 4.19.1/). This record governs the CWE material kept at source level: the derived data under scripts-extra/output/ (CWE-Basic-Data.csv restates CWE IDs, names and descriptions; CWE-AI-Classifications.* and its report add CSA's AI-relevance classification) and this README. CSA's own analysis notes (analysis/) and tooling (scripts/, scripts-extra/) are listed in the tier gate's TYPE_ROOT_INFRASTRUCTURE and pinned instead.

license.notes: CWE Terms of Use (checked 2026-11-14): "CWE™ is free to use by any organization or individual for any research, development, and/or commercial purposes"; MITRE grants a non-exclusive, royalty-free licence, on the condition that copies reproduce MITRE's copyright designation and the licence. The classification columns in CWE-AI-Classifications.* are CSA's own work.

tier_evidence.note: The CWE downloads page and Terms of Use read with no login (HTTP 200), and the CWE CSV and XML downloads are linked from it. mitre.org is not a government domain, so Tier 2.

desired_end_state.notes: Source-level record; the editions are the version directories.

notes: Added 2026-11-14 (dataset-public-laws-regulations-standards#154) so that the derived CWE data kept at source level has a governing record.
